purpose: Confirm or falsify a bounded no-practical-advantage hypothesis for the unchanged ArcLLM architecture on the same two frozen W-S/W-C regimes.

hypotheses.H_NPA: Across both frozen workloads, the unchanged ArcLLM architecture does not demonstrate a practically meaningful matched advantage that reproduces in two fresh sessions.
hypotheses.falsification: H_NPA is falsified only if the same predeclared primary benefit dimension satisfies the practical-advantage gate in the same workload independently in both fresh sessions A and B.

practical_advantage_gate.stability_required: 5/5 successful measured attempts for both systems in the candidate workload in each session

adjudication.unresolved_only_for: evidence-invalidating measurement/infrastructure failure that prevents adjudication; never to avoid a negative result

stop_rule.on_FEASIBLE_NO_DEMONSTRATED_ADVANTAGE: Close the current ArcLLM architecture line. Do not continue iterative tuning or benchmark search.
stop_rule.on_REGIME_ADVANTAGE_SUPPORTED: Freeze the supported regime claim and evidence; no generalized 'ArcLLM is faster/better' claim beyond the proven regime.

post_negative_architecture_intervention_.required_stage: separate Architecture Intervention Review after final ArcLLM verdict
post_negative_architecture_intervention_.role_of_nexus: hypothesis source only; NEXUS results are not ArcLLM evidence and cannot be transferred as proof
reopening_requirements: current ArcLLM architecture line is formally closed
Q2/Q3 bottleneck is explicitly mapped to a mechanism
specific NEXUS finding has a mechanistic causal rationale for that bottleneck
one bounded architecture intervention is frozen with falsification condition, resource budget, and stop condition
new intervention is treated as a successor architecture study, not retroactive tuning of Q3
